## Evidence (required)

We can only accept changes backed by an open or official source. Link at least one of:

- OpenStreetMap object or changeset
- Wikidata item / statement
- Official statistics or gazetteer (NRS, ONS, CSO, logainm.ie, etc.)
- Operator or government page with a clear licence

## Notes for reviewers

- Curated spine islands (`source: curated`) need extra care — do not overwrite without maintainer sign-off.
- Accepted factual fixes should be applied via ingestion scripts / `curated.json`, not hand-edits to `islands.json` in the browser.
